findings.summary: The curriculum table's scrollable control boundary has insufficient contrast against its background.
findings.fix: Use a border color that contrasts at least 3:1 with the surrounding surface, such as a darker neutral than --line.
findings.evidence: The scroll container uses --line (#e3e1d8) against the near-white panel, approximately 1.3:1.

passed: Curriculum detail text colors meet normal-text contrast requirements.
Curriculum detail links, buttons, and the keyboard-focusable scroll region have visible focus indicators.
Required/elective and subject status are conveyed with text, not color alone.
